p.em: (Be sure that you can carefully put into words the meanings of each of these statement in terms of ice cream and money.)

static.solution:
(a) The statement f(250) = 400 means that it costs 400 dollars to produce 250 gallons of ice cream.
(b) The statement f'(250) = 1.2 means that when the number of gallons produced is 250, costs are increasing by 1.2 dollars/gallon In other words, it costs about 1.2 dollars to produce the 251st gallon of ice cream.
